name: OE Skills X5 v1.1.0
body:
## OE Skills X5 v1.1.0

- Route ordinary X5 ONNX/Caffe quantization through PTQ by default. Use Plugin QAT when explicitly requested or when PTQ evaluation shows it cannot meet the target.
- Prefer a verified, version-matched X5 OE Docker image for toolchain work. Host execution now requires explicit opt-in.
- Add read-only Docker probes for PTQ CLI availability and QAT Plugin, March.BAYES_E, and CUDA visibility. GPU visibility alone does not validate training or convergence.
- Refresh all 22 Skill versions, routing policy, environment snapshot contract, and documentation.

Validation: 21 source tests passed locally and in the X5 CPU Docker image on sz-dev. The new PTQ and QAT Docker probe functions were run against local CPU and GPU images on sz-dev and both verified. Model quantization, accuracy, training, and board inference were not run.
